package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_io_operations_readall_on_known_large_file: Layer: I/O operations. Flag os.ReadFile or io.ReadAll on files that are processed sequentially.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario549Positive(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	// Reads an entire known-large file into memory at once.
	// For line-by-line or streaming processing this is wasteful
	// and may cause OOM on multi-GB files.
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return data, nil
}
